grammar.pattern: 多久 / 为什么 / 怎么样 / 怎样
grammar.purpose: Ask for duration, reason or manner
grammar.explanation: 多久 asks duration, not a clock time: 坐车要多久 versus 几点出发. 为什么 asks a reason. 怎么样 often asks an evaluation or condition: 味道怎么样. 怎样 can ask the manner of doing something: 怎样去, and can also ask an evaluation. Put the question word where the missing information belongs; these questions do not need 吗. A reason may use 因为, taught more fully later; a simple 因为 clause is a useful recognition answer here.

examples.zh: 坐车要多久？二十分钟。几点出发？六点。
examples.py: zuò chē yào duō jiǔ ? èr shí fēn zhōng . jǐ diǎn chū fā ? liù diǎn .
examples.en: How long by vehicle? Twenty minutes. What time do we leave? Six.

examples.zh: 为什么选这里？这里安静。味道怎么样？不错。
examples.py: wèi shén me xuǎn zhè lǐ ? zhè lǐ ān jìng . wèi dao zěn me yàng ? bù cuò .
examples.en: Why choose here? It is quiet. How does it taste? Good.

examples.zh: 怎样去？坐车到大学站，再走五分钟。
examples.py: zěn yàng qù ? zuò chē dào dà xué zhàn , zài zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng .
examples.en: How do we get there? Ride to University Station, then walk five minutes.

commonMistakes.why: Do not add 吗 to this question-word duration question.

grammar.pattern: 什么时候 / 什么样 / 为什么 / 怎么样 / 怎样
grammar.purpose: Choose the information a question requests
grammar.explanation: 什么时候 asks when; 什么样 asks kind or characteristics; 为什么 asks why; 怎么样/怎样 ask a condition, evaluation or way. Use context to disambiguate 怎样. 什么样的饭馆 is a kind question, not a request for the restaurant name. A preference answer is one person’s view and does not establish a universal quality ranking.

examples.zh: 什么时候去？今晚。想去什么样的饭馆？安静一点的。
examples.py: shén me shí hou qù ? jīn wǎn . xiǎng qù shén me yàng de fàn guǎn ? ān jìng yī diǎn de .
examples.en: When shall we go? Tonight. What kind of restaurant? A somewhat quieter one.

examples.zh: 为什么不叫外卖？想出去走走。这里服务怎么样？很热情。
examples.py: wèi shén me bù jiào wài mài ? xiǎng chū qù zǒu zǒu . zhè lǐ fú wù zěn me yàng ? hěn rè qíng .
examples.en: Why not order delivery? I want a walk. How is the service here? Welcoming.

examples.zh: 你认为怎样去合适？坐车吧。
examples.py: nǐ rèn wéi zěn yàng qù hé shì ? zuò chē ba .
examples.en: What way of getting there do you think is suitable? Let us take a vehicle.

commonMistakes.why: 什么时候 asks a time; 什么样 asks a kind or characteristic.

lines.zh: 晚上出去吃吧？我想找个安静的地方。
lines.py: wǎn shang chū qù chī ba ? wǒ xiǎng zhǎo gè ān jìng de dì fāng .
lines.en: Want to eat out tonight? I'd like somewhere quiet.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好啊。你想吃什么？
lines.py: hǎo a . nǐ xiǎng chī shén me ?
lines.en: Sure. What would you like?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 今天不想吃快餐，也不想叫外卖。
lines.py: jīn tiān bù xiǎng chī kuài cān , yě bù xiǎng jiào wài mài .
lines.en: I don't want fast food or delivery today.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那去我家附近那家饭馆吧，菜的味道不错。
lines.py: nà qù wǒ jiā fù jìn nà jiā fàn guǎn ba , cài de wèi dào bù cuò .
lines.en: Then let's go to the restaurant near my home. The food's good.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你去过？
lines.py: nǐ qù guò ?
lines.en: Have you been?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 去过，上周和小周一起去的。
lines.py: qù guò , shàng zhōu hé xiǎo zhōu yì qǐ qù de .
lines.en: Yes, with Xiao Zhou last week.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 要等很久吗？
lines.py: yào děng hěn jiǔ ma ?
lines.en: Is the wait long?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 大概二十分钟。你饿了吗？
lines.py: dà gài èr shí fēn zhōng . nǐ è le ma ?
lines.en: About twenty minutes. Are you hungry?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 还好。我们六点出发，怎么样？
lines.py: hái hǎo . wǒ men liù diǎn chū fā , zěn me yàng ?
lines.en: Not too hungry. Shall we leave at six?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行。坐车十分钟，再走五分钟。
lines.py: xíng . zuò chē shí fēn zhōng , zài zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng .
lines.en: Okay. Ten minutes by bus, then a five-minute walk.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 到了以后，你帮我点菜吧。不要太辣。
lines.py: dào le yǐ hòu , nǐ bāng wǒ diǎn cài ba . bú yào tài là .
lines.en: Help me order when we get there. Nothing too spicy.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。我们先点两个菜，不够再加。
lines.py: hǎo . wǒ men xiān diǎn liǎng gè cài , bù gòu zài jiā .
lines.en: Okay. We'll start with two dishes and order more if we need them.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: Separate the reasons
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 下班以后，我约陈宇出去吃饭。中午已经吃过快餐，晚上想找一家安静的饭馆，坐下来慢慢聊。
lines.py: xià bān yǐ hòu , wǒ yuē chén yǔ chū qù chī fàn . zhōng wǔ yǐ jīng chī guò kuài cān , wǎn shang xiǎng zhǎo yī jiā ān jìng de fàn guǎn , zuò xià lái màn màn liáo .
lines.en: After work I asked Chen Yu to eat out. I'd already had fast food at lunch and wanted a quiet restaurant where we could sit and chat.

lines.zh: 陈宇说他家附近有一家，菜的味道不错。他上周和小周去过，不过那天等了二十分钟才有座位。
lines.py: chén yǔ shuō tā jiā fù jìn yǒu yī jiā , cài de wèi dào bù cuò . tā shàng zhōu hé xiǎo zhōu qù guò , bù guò nà tiān děng le èr shí fēn zhōng cái yǒu zuò wèi .
lines.en: He knew one near his home with good food. He and Xiao Zhou had gone the previous week, though they'd waited twenty minutes for seats.

lines.zh: 我们六点出发，坐车十分钟，再走五分钟。进门时前面还有两位顾客，服务员请我们在门边等一会儿。
lines.py: wǒ men liù diǎn chū fā , zuò chē shí fēn zhōng , zài zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng . jìn mén shí qián miàn hái yǒu liǎng wèi gù kè , fú wù yuán qǐng wǒ men zài mén biān děng yī huì er .
lines.en: We left at six, rode the bus for ten minutes and walked another five. Two customers were ahead of us; a server asked us to wait by the entrance.

lines.zh: 这次只等了十分钟。坐下以后，陈宇先问我想吃什么。我不太能吃辣，就点了炒鸡蛋和一盘青菜。
lines.py: zhè cì zhǐ děng le shí fēn zhōng . zuò xià yǐ hòu , chén yǔ xiān wèn wǒ xiǎng chī shén me . wǒ bù tài néng chī là , jiù diǎn le chǎo jī dàn hé yī pán qīng cài .
lines.en: This time the wait was only ten minutes. Once seated, Chen Yu asked what I'd like. I can't eat very spicy food, so I ordered scrambled eggs and a plate of greens.

lines.zh: 菜来得很快，我对味道很满意。陈宇说上周也好吃，就是那次等得久，他有点不满。
lines.py: cài lái de hěn kuài , wǒ duì wèi dào hěn mǎn yì . chén yǔ shuō shàng zhōu yě hǎo chī , jiù shì nà cì děng de jiǔ , tā yǒu diǎn bù mǎn .
lines.en: The food came quickly and I liked it very much. Chen Yu said last week's food was good too; he'd just been a little unhappy about the long wait.

lines.zh: 吃完我们走回车站，他问下次还来不来。我说来啊，不过午餐别再叫我吃快餐了，今天想换换。
lines.py: chī wán wǒ men zǒu huí chē zhàn , tā wèn xià cì hái lái bù lái . wǒ shuō lái a , bù guò wǔ cān bié zài jiào wǒ chī kuài cān le , jīn tiān xiǎng huàn huàn .
lines.en: After dinner we walked back to the stop. Would I come again? Yes, I said, but please don't invite me for fast food at lunch again. I wanted a change today.

choices: They enjoy the food after a short wait
questions.answer: They enjoy the food after a short wait

lines.en: The child is asleep. The room is quiet.

lines.zh: 怎样去这家饭馆？
lines.py: zěn yàng qù zhè jiā fàn guǎn ?
lines.en: How do we get to this restaurant?

lines.zh: 这张表怎样填？
lines.py: zhè zhāng biǎo zěn yàng tián ?
lines.en: How do I fill in this form?

lines.zh: 坐车要多久？
lines.py: zuò chē yào duō jiǔ ?
lines.en: How long does it take by vehicle?

lines.zh: 你在北京住了多久？
lines.py: nǐ zài běi jīng zhù le duō jiǔ ?
lines.en: How long have you lived in Beijing?

lines.zh: 你想去什么样的饭馆？
lines.py: nǐ xiǎng qù shén me yàng de fàn guǎn ?
lines.en: What kind of restaurant would you like?

lines.zh: 她喜欢什么样的电影？
lines.py: tā xǐ huān shén me yàng de diàn yǐng ?
lines.en: What kind of films does she like?

lines.zh: 我认为这里适合聊天。
lines.py: wǒ rèn wéi zhè lǐ shì hé liáo tiān .
lines.en: I think this place is suitable for chatting.

lines.zh: 我认为这本书值得再读一次。
lines.py: wǒ rèn wéi zhè běn shū zhí de zài dú yī cì .
lines.en: I think this book is worth reading again.

lines.zh: 你的看法和我的不同。
lines.py: nǐ de kàn fǎ hé wǒ de bù tóng .
lines.en: Your view is different from mine.

lines.zh: 看完电影，我们聊了聊各自的看法。
lines.py: kàn wán diàn yǐng , wǒ men liáo le liáo gè zì de kàn fǎ .
lines.en: After the film we talked about what each of us thought.

lines.zh: 选这里的原因是安静。
lines.py: xuǎn zhè lǐ de yuán yīn shì ān jìng .
lines.en: The reason for choosing here is that it is quiet.

lines.zh: 他迟到的原因是坐错了车。
lines.py: tā chí dào de yuán yīn shì zuò cuò le chē .
lines.en: He was late because he took the wrong bus.

lines.zh: 这里的好处是离家近。
lines.py: zhè lǐ de hǎo chù shì lí jiā jìn .
lines.en: The advantage here is that it is close to home.

lines.zh: 住得近的好处是可以走路上班。
lines.py: zhù de jìn de hǎo chù shì kě yǐ zǒu lù shàng bān .
lines.en: The advantage of living nearby is being able to walk to work.

lines.zh: 这里的坏处是要等很久。
lines.py: zhè lǐ de huài chù shì yào děng hěn jiǔ .
lines.en: The disadvantage here is a long wait.

lines.zh: 睡得太晚有什么坏处？
lines.py: shuì de tài wǎn yǒu shén me huài chù ?
lines.en: What are the drawbacks of going to bed too late?

lines.zh: 这个菜的味道不错。
lines.py: zhè gè cài de wèi dào bù cuò .
lines.en: This dish tastes good.

lines.zh: 这杯茶的味道和昨天的不一样。
lines.py: zhè bēi chá de wèi dào hé zuó tiān de bù yī yàng .
lines.en: This tea tastes different from yesterday's.

lines.zh: 这家饭馆不大，但很干净。
lines.py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn bù dà , dàn hěn gān jìng .
lines.en: This restaurant is not big, but it is clean.

lines.zh: 车站对面新开了一家饭馆。
lines.py: chē zhàn duì miàn xīn kāi le yī jiā fàn guǎn .
lines.en: A new restaurant has opened opposite the station.

lines.zh: 午餐我吃快餐，晚餐想慢慢吃。
lines.py: wǔ cān wǒ chī kuài cān , wǎn cān xiǎng màn màn chī .
lines.en: I had fast food for lunch and want to eat dinner slowly.

lines.zh: 楼下的快餐店十二点人最多。
lines.py: lóu xià de kuài cān diàn shí èr diǎn rén zuì duō .
lines.en: The fast-food place downstairs is busiest at noon.

lines.zh: 今天不想叫外卖，我想出去走走。
lines.py: jīn tiān bù xiǎng jiào wài mài , wǒ xiǎng chū qù zǒu zǒu .
lines.en: I do not want delivery food today; I would like to go out for a walk.

lines.zh: 雨太大了，我们叫外卖吧。
lines.py: yǔ tài dà le , wǒ men jiào wài mài ba .
lines.en: It's raining hard. Let's order delivery.

lines.zh: 昨天吃方便面，今天想吃米饭。
lines.py: zuó tiān chī fāng biàn miàn , jīn tiān xiǎng chī mǐ fàn .
lines.en: I had instant noodles yesterday and want rice today.

lines.zh: 家里还有两包方便面。
lines.py: jiā lǐ hái yǒu liǎng bāo fāng biàn miàn .
lines.en: There are still two packets of instant noodles at home.

lines.zh: 这家店服务顾客很热情。
lines.py: zhè jiā diàn fú wù gù kè hěn rè qíng .
lines.en: This shop serves customers warmly.

lines.zh: 这家旅馆的服务很好。
lines.py: zhè jiā lǚ guǎn de fú wù hěn hǎo .
lines.en: The service at this hotel is very good.

lines.zh: 顾客正在等座位。
lines.py: gù kè zhèng zài děng zuò wèi .
lines.en: The customers are waiting for seats.

lines.zh: 店里只有一位顾客。
lines.py: diàn lǐ zhǐ yǒu yī wèi gù kè .
lines.en: There's only one customer in the shop.

lines.zh: 我对今天的菜很满意。
lines.py: wǒ duì jīn tiān de cài hěn mǎn yì .
lines.en: I am very satisfied with today’s food.

lines.zh: 照片拍得很好，我很满意。
lines.py: zhào piān pāi de hěn hǎo , wǒ hěn mǎn yì .
lines.en: The photo came out well. I'm very happy with it.

lines.zh: 我对等了很久有点不满。
lines.py: wǒ duì děng le hěn jiǔ yǒu diǎn bù mǎn .
lines.en: I am a little dissatisfied with the long wait.

lines.zh: 她对这个安排不满，想换个时间。
lines.py: tā duì zhè gè ān pái bù mǎn , xiǎng huàn gè shí jiān .
lines.en: She's unhappy with this arrangement and wants a different time.

lines.zh: 有些菜不辣，比如这个鸡蛋。
lines.py: yǒu xiē cài bù là , bǐ rú zhè gè jī dàn .
lines.en: Some dishes are not spicy, for example this egg dish.

lines.zh: 周末可以做很多事，比如看书、散步。
lines.py: zhōu mò kě yǐ zuò hěn duō shì , bǐ rú kàn shū , sàn bù .
lines.en: There's plenty to do at weekends, like reading or walking.

lines.zh: 我们的口味不同。
lines.py: wǒ men de kǒu wèi bù tóng .
lines.en: Our tastes are different.

lines.zh: 我们住在不同的城市。
lines.py: wǒ men zhù zài bù tóng de chéng shì .
lines.en: We live in different cities.

lines.zh: 顾客正在等座位。
lines.py: gù kè zhèng zài děng zuò wèi .
lines.en: The customers are waiting for seats.

lines.zh: 窗边还有一个座位。
lines.py: chuāng biān hái yǒu yī gè zuò wèi .
lines.en: There's another seat by the window.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 二05, 二76. Native check: collocations for customer service and dissatisfaction, the nominal use of 快餐/外卖, clipped original verse, and exactly which time interval 多久 refers to. No restaurant recommendation, reservation or objective star rating is claimed. Planned retrieval 一01 / 一31 / 二02 / 二75: 北门。学校前边，路的东边。, 我该带什么？你应该先问主人。, 六点半来，好吗？带书怎么样？, 我带两瓶水，可以吗？行吗？.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Targeted HSK 2 naturalness review: natural 点了炒鸡蛋和一盘青菜 replaces generic dish wording, with precise passage glosses and aligned English; restaurant choice with a previous twenty-minute wait versus ten minutes today; two red scarves with different shoes, blue layer packed; printing only pages two/three at two and handing them over at three, Saturday event at two; activity-room discussion with a normal four-o’clock chime and Saturday three meeting. Removed assessment, identity and consent lectures inside friendly speech. All existing word/task IDs preserved. First examples retained where suitable, specific awkward examples fixed; every word also has an independently authored second context. Abstract education, behaviour and action vocabulary stays in separate examples rather than forced conversation. False statements checked against their own audio. Native flags: 为 beneficiary register, 取得成绩/同意 versus 拿到, educational 教师/教育/教学/中小学/年级 terms, 求 playful plea, 满意/不满 and 好处/坏处, adjective 色 forms, 站住 request strength, formal 受到/行动/行为 and colloquial 挺好. Native review pending. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
